summary: Complaints centre on land and revenue grievances in Behat tehsil, illegal Yamuna mining and unsafe travel on the Delhi-Yamunotri highway, while canal irrigation, mango orchards and handicrafts are the main points of appreciation, though local evidence is thin and several items are inference.

positives.english: Canal water reaches our fields, so the crops grow well
positives.hindi: नहर का पानी है, इसलिए यहां के खेतों में फसल अच्छी होती है
positives.basis: Wikipedia (Behat town article, Economy section, undated): the Western Yamuna Canal 'irrigates most of the arable land in Behat'. Verified on 12 Oct 2026.

positives.english: Mango orchards are our pride and our livelihood
positives.hindi: आम के बाग़ ही यहां की पहचान और रोज़ी-रोटी हैं
positives.basis: Wikipedia (Behat town article, undated): 'mango orchards slowly took over as mainstay of the economy'. The same article names guavas only as one fruit the town is known for, so guava orchards are not claimed here. Verified on 12 Oct 2026.

positives.english: Our local craftsmen make brass bells and wrought-iron goods
positives.hindi: पीतल की घंटियां और लोहे का सामान यहां के कारीगर बनाते हैं
positives.basis: Wikipedia (Behat town article, introduction, undated) names 'brass bells, and wrought iron handicrafts' as local products. Verified on 12 Oct 2026.

positives.english: *The Delhi-Yamunotri highway makes travel to Saharanpur easy
positives.hindi: *दिल्ली-यमुनोत्री हाईवे पर होने से सहारनपुर आना-जाना आसान है
positives.basis: Inference: Wikipedia places Behat on NH-709B, about 30 km north of Saharanpur, and Amar Ujala (10 Dec 2021) calls the road the Delhi-Yamunotri highway. The 'easy travel' point is not stated in any source reached.

positives.english: *Behat's CHC gives first treatment in an emergency before referral
positives.hindi: *बेहट सीएचसी में पहला इलाज मिल जाता है, फिर ज़िला अस्पताल भेजते हैं
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (10 Dec 2021) reports that after a fatal three-bike crash near Babail Bujurg, the three injured were given first aid at Behat CHC and referred to the district hospital. This is one incident, not a general finding.

negatives.english: Officials take bribes and poor families lose their land in Behat tehsil
negatives.hindi: तहसील में रिश्वत चलती है, गरीब की ज़मीन भू-माफिया के नाम चढ़ जाती है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (21 Feb 2025, Dimple Sirohi): Dalit and Muslim women of village Begpur Naugaanwa, Behat tehsil, locked the tehsil gate. They say more than 100 families on about 14 bigha were evicted after the Naib Tehsildar and Halka Lekhpal allegedly took money from a land mafia. These are the women's allegations, not established findings. No official response appears in the text read. Verified on 12 Oct 2026.

negatives.english: Illegal mining in the Yamuna near Behat keeps happening, and cases are registered
negatives.hindi: यमुना में अवैध खनन चलता है, बेहट थाने में केस दर्ज हुए हैं
negatives.basis: Tribune (5 Dec 2024): owners of six stone crushers and screening plants were booked for alleged illegal mining in the Yamuna on the UP side, at Pratap Pur and Alamgirpur Gurjar villages. The case was registered at Behat police station, Saharanpur. Allegations only. Not confirmed that these villages are inside the Behat AC boundary, and the article does not say which tehsil the police station serves. Verified on 12 Oct 2026.

negatives.english: Behat has seen little development in seventy years
negatives.hindi: बेहट में सत्तर सालों में विकास बहुत कम हुआ है
negatives.basis: Wikipedia (Behat town article, History section, undated): 'the government has neglected the area; as a result, Behat has made little progress in last 70 years.' This is the article's editorial claim, not a voter statement. Verified on 12 Oct 2026.

negatives.english: *Speeding vehicles on the highway near Behat put people at risk
negatives.hindi: *बेहट के पास हाईवे पर तेज़ रफ़्तार गाड़ियां जान का खतरा बनी रहती हैं
negatives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (10 Dec 2021) reports a fatal three-bike collision on the Delhi-Yamunotri highway near Babail Bujurg, Behat. The report does not mention speed or road conditions, and it is from 2021, so it is not recent.

negatives.english: *Mango growers do not get a fair price or enough support for their crop
negatives.hindi: *आम के बागवानों को फसल का सही दाम और मदद नहीं मिलती
negatives.basis: Inference: Wikipedia says mango orchards are the town's mainstay, but no price or support complaint was found in any source reached. The 2024-2026 searches did not surface a Behat report on this.

round2.changes: Verified all cited URLs by WebFetch. Confirmed AC 1 Behat, Saharanpur, None, 372,305 electors on the Wikipedia list. Wikipedia Behat: canal, brass bells, mango mainstay and 'little progress in last 70 years' confirmed; guava orchards and the 200-year claim were not in the article, so the mango item was reworded and its basis corrected. NH-709B and 30 km confirmed; 'Delhi-Yamunotri' name taken from Amar Ujala 2021. Amar Ujala 2025 video confirmed (21 Feb 2025, Begpur Naugaanwa, Behat tehsil). Amar Ujala 2021 crash confirmed (Behat CHC first aid, then district hospital); speed not mentioned. Removed the drinking-water negative (no source; its Wikipedia citation dropped) and replaced it with a sourced Yamuna illegal-mining negative (Tribune 5 Dec 2024). Shortened the CHC Hindi line to 12 words. Re-ranked negatives: land, mining, development, speeding (inference), mango prices (inference).

notes: Identity confirmed from the Wikipedia UP constituency list (No. 1 Behat, district Saharanpur, reserved status None, 372,305 electors) and the Behat constituency page (formed 2008; MLA Umar Ali Khan, SP, elected 2022). Wikipedia's Behat town article gives population as 8,574 in the infobox and 20,474 in the census text, so it is internally inconsistent; not used. Round 2 budget: about 16 WebFetch and 14 WebSearch calls in total across both rounds. Coverage is still thin. Behat AC boundary: neither the Wikipedia constituency page nor any search result listed the villages in the AC. Mirzapur and Shakumbhari could not be confirmed as inside Behat AC (Shakumbhari is cited only as a Ghad-area flood story, not used). Sarsawa is said in search snippets to be partly merged into Behat in 2008, but this was not confirmed on a fetched page. Two parliamentary records (eparlib.sansad.in 9401.pdf and 7412.pdf) appeared in search and describe Yamuna erosion threatening dozens of Behat villages (Ninhari, Jodhewas, Kansepur and others) and hill rivers (Solani, Hindon, Chachrao, Maskara, Nagadev, Ramaula). Both returned HTTP 503 on fetch, so they are NOT cited. They are a lead for field checks and a later round. An Amar Ujala 18 Sep 2025 report on flooded rivers near the Shakumbhari Devi shrine (Ghad area) was opened but does not name Behat, so it is not cited. Not found in any source: 2024-2026 Behat reports on cane dues, power cuts, roads, stray cattle, monkeys or water; the Patrika 1 Aug 2026 item on an SP MLC procession clash is political and was not used. Negative 4 (speeding, based on a 2021 crash), negative 5 (mango prices), and positives 4 and 5 are inference and need field checks. Only one Behat-specific 2025 report was found (Amar Ujala, 21 Feb 2025). The Behat mining item is police-station-level; its village boundary is unconfirmed.
